what: A sample of the miniatures of MZ4250, every tenth STL in name order, each stored as .bread and eight other lossless ways. Sizes in bytes, times in milliseconds.

credit.creator: MZ4250
credit.changes: Only measured: each STL was read, welded and written as .bread in memory. No model is redistributed.

machine: a desktop PC: AMD Ryzen 7 5800X (8 cores, 16 threads), 32 GB, Windows 11 Pro, Rust 1.99.1. Models measured one at a time; each format written once and read back into corners, the fastest of three kept. Zstandard on all 16 threads, as zstd -T0; .bread as the reference implementation writes and reads it, some steps side by side on threads; zip, gzip and 3MF on one thread

formats.stl: binary STL, written from the mesh with its facet normals
formats.stl_zip_9: the binary STL in a zip, Deflate at level 9
formats.stl_zstd_3: the binary STL with Zstandard at level 3, its default
formats.stl_zstd_19: the binary STL with Zstandard at level 19
formats.obj: OBJ, every coordinate as the shortest decimal that reads back as the same f32
formats.obj_gzip_9: that OBJ with gzip at level 9
formats.obj_zstd_19: that OBJ with Zstandard at level 19
formats.3mf: 3MF: its model, with the same decimals, in a zip at Deflate's default level 6
